column1: # Ashfall's new Psynergy, in empty ability slots 130 to 136 (abilities.c),
# each drawn with an animation the original game never showed. Names are
# MsgAbilityName + id (819 + id), descriptions MsgAbilityDescription + id
# Falling Wind (ability 137): Mia's two-part move, a storm on the enemies and
# a revive of every fallen ally, after the leaf-and-wind ability she uses in a
# pre-release screenshot.
# "???"'s summon (ability 138, ABILITY_P_STORM_SUMMON), her finisher.
# Falling Wind's cast line (battle/battle/turn.c): Mia remembers it, as the move
# remembers the leaf-and-wind ability of a pre-release screenshot.
# Its revive, which follows the storm when an ally is down.
# The heroes' finishers (abilities 151 to 157, mystic_artes.c), after the Tales
# series' mystic artes: Isaac's after Zankuu Tenshouken, Garet's after Mary's
# "ZAN!", Ivan's after Philia's Rebirth Crusader, and Mia's after Garr's
# Sekkazan, where she gives everything and falls.
